EXACT_CURRENT_MISSING_LINK.reason: The frozen reducer leaves every F_p unchanged, so the structural obstruction question is exactly the treewidth behavior of G_p=Inc(F_p). Existence and fixpoint stability alone do not imply width growth.

EXACT_INCIDENCE_GRAPH.degree_profile: variable degree 15; clause degree 3; maximum degree 15
EXACT_INCIDENCE_GRAPH.type_system: 18 vertex types over cyclic coordinate F_p: A,B,C,E_0,...,E_14
EXACT_INCIDENCE_GRAPH.translation_symmetry: x -> x+t is an automorphism for every t in F_p

CYCLIC_REINDEXING_UPPER_BOUND_ATTEMPT.name: SIMULTANEOUS_DIOPHANTINE_REINDEXING_CYCLIC_BANDWIDTH_BOUND
CYCLIC_REINDEXING_UPPER_BOUND_ATTEMPT.simultaneous_approximation_lemma: Two distinct v_t,v_u occupy the same one of K_p^14 boxes. For q=t-u mod p, q is nonzero and therefore invertible. For every j=1,...,14, the centered residue norm ||q(s_j-s_0)||_p is at most M_p. Thus M_p=O(p^(13/14)). The exponent 13/14 comes from 14 simultaneous relative shifts: p divided by p^(1/14). No independence/randomness of the shifts is assumed.

layout.delta_j: delta_j=q(s_j-s_0) mod p, chosen with centered representative of magnitude <=M_p; delta_0=0

explicit_path_decomposition.case_2M_ge_p: Use the single full-vertex bag. Since |V(G_p)|=18p and 2M_p>=p, width <=18p-1<=36M_p-1.
explicit_path_decomposition.case_2M_lt_p: Cut the cyclic coordinate at 0. Put into boundary S all vertices in the first M_p and last M_p coordinate fibres, so |S|<=36M_p. Every edge with both endpoints outside S has ordinary non-wrapping coordinate span <=M_p. Use a sliding path decomposition whose bag is S plus at most M_p+1 consecutive interior fibres. Each edge is covered and each vertex has a contiguous bag interval.
explicit_path_decomposition.uniform_width_bound: tw(G_p) <= 54 M_p + 17 for every prime p>=17

CYCLIC_REINDEXING_UPPER_BOUND_ATTEMPT.proof_authority: ANALYTIC_GRAPH_THEOREM_FOR_THIS_EXACT_FAMILY; NO TREEWIDTH SOFTWARE OR FINITE FIT USED

PROVED_OR_BROKEN_STEP.possible_future_improvement: OPEN; algebraic dependence among the specific primitive-root shifts could conceivably yield a smaller upper exponent, but no such improvement is assumed here

TREEWIDTH_CLAIM_CEILING.power_law_lower_bound_constraint: Any future valid lower bound Omega(p^alpha) for this family must have alpha<=13/14.
TREEWIDTH_CLAIM_CEILING.expansion_scope: Any bounded-degree expansion notion strong enough to force linear-size balanced separators / Omega(p) treewidth cannot hold uniformly for this family. This does not rule out weaker or scale-dependent expansion proxies.

MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_LOWER_BOUND_TARGET.target_for_falsifying_H1_on_this_frozen_: tw(Inc(F_p))=omega(log p) along the prime-indexed family
MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_LOWER_BOUND_TARGET.separator_form_sufficient_for_target: sep_2_3(G_p)=omega(log p), where sep_2_3 is the minimum size of a vertex separator whose remaining components each have at most 2|V(G_p)|/3 vertices
MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_LOWER_BOUND_TARGET.implication: Every graph of treewidth k has a balanced separator of size at most k+1; therefore a superlogarithmic lower bound on minimum balanced-separator size implies tw(G_p)=omega(log p).
MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_LOWER_BOUND_TARGET.why_this_is_enough: The reducer leaves F_p unchanged and the frozen family size parameters satisfy variables=3p, clauses=15p, occurrences=45p, so log of every natural linear-size structural parameter is Theta(log p). A proof of omega(log p) residual incidence treewidth would contradict an O(log n) universal residual-width claim for this exact reducer.
MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_LOWER_BOUND_TARGET.stronger_H3_style_target: Omega(p^alpha) for any explicit alpha>0 would be stronger and compatible with H3's width-rate shape, but is not minimally necessary to falsify the O(log n) funnel claim and would still not by itself prove H3 without the remaining H3 premises.

WIDTH_LOWER_CANDIDATE.statement: sep_2_3(G_p)=omega(log p), and hence tw(G_p)=omega(log p), along primes p>=17
WIDTH_LOWER_CANDIDATE.proof_route_selected: BALANCED_SEPARATOR_LOWER_BOUND_USING_THE_EXACT_TRANSLATION_INVARIANT_18_TYPE_CYCLIC_GRAPH; additive/Fourier structure may be used analytically, but constant-expansion assumptions are forbidden because WU already rules out a linear-width conclusion
WIDTH_LOWER_CANDIDATE.reason_for_selection: This is the weakest clean structural fact sufficient to falsify the frozen O(log n) funnel on a family that is already proved to be an unchanged reducer fixpoint.

CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS_ONE_THING_TO_PROVE: Prove sep_2_3(Inc(F_p))=omega(log p), or equivalently for our purpose derive the consequent tw(Inc(F_p))=omega(log p), for the explicit prime-indexed family. That is the first missing theorem that would turn the already-proved infinite reducer fixpoint family into a genuine counterexample to this frozen reducer's O(log n) universal structural-funnel claim.
